name: harness-humanizer
description: Removes AI-slop from prose (empty hedging, listicle stems, smooth transitions, generic filler) and rewrites toward a real point of view — without trading AI-slop for louder slop. Self-scores against an embedded rubric, flags hollow spans instead of fabricating, and reports rather than overwrites. Portable to every AI tool via generated adapters; ships a zero-dependency CLI flagger.
